bar-dolly.desc: Real in-game render: the camera drifts from behind the bar out over the counter toward the lit table (POWERJACK neon, jukebox, three shades) and back; 8 s seamless loop.

the-shot.desc: Real in-game render, first person: you lean down over the cue ball, the bridge hand plants, two slow practice strokes, then the break and the rack spreading.

rain-window.desc: Real in-game render: rain on the storefront glass, the reversed COLD BEER neon, a lightning bolt (two strokes 0.65 s apart) lighting the glass and the ledge; 5 s seamless loop (the last second dissolves into the first).

neon-wakes.desc: The POWERJACK sign wakes letter by letter, the J last: cut by this page from two frames the game rendered, lit and unlit.
